hero.title: Built around your method.<line2>Not the other way around.</line2>
hero.sub: Where other journals lock you into their fixed fields, Beyen bends entirely to you. Every setup, condition and rule, set up the way you actually trade, with numbers that hold up on top of TradingView.
hero.note: The free tier is a complete, working journal. No card, no trial clock.

band.statement: Built by a trader. For traders.
band.sub: Only the analysis a serious trader actually uses. Nothing added to pad a feature list.

m.lead: Trade ICT, breakout, mean-reversion or something entirely your own. The journal builds itself around your checklist: add enum and yes/no fields, or start from a preset and refine it. Every field instantly becomes a filter and a breakdown in the analysis.
m.lead2: Multiple journals side by side, each with its own fields, trades and reviews. Forex swings and index scalps never pollute each other's numbers.

c.excl: Missed trade excluded from all numbers
c.lead: A journal is only worth anything if you trust the numbers. So Beyen hides nothing from you, even when the truth stings. Not a setting you switch on, just how it counts.
c.p1h: Missed trades never pollute your numbers
c.p1b: Log a setup you spotted but didn't take with a hypothetical result. It never counts toward the real result, the win rate, streaks or drawdown.
c.p2h: Break-even pauses your streak, but doesn't reset it
c.p2b: A BE isn't a loss. Your winning and losing streaks stay true to how you actually traded.
c.p3h: Avg R, drawdown and streaks, chronologically computed
c.p3b: Cumulative result by date, R-multiple per trade, average R per setup. Enough to know whether your edge is real.

e.h2: Where the edge is. And where the leak is.
e.lead: Beyen breaks your results down by your own fields: per setup, per bias, per condition. Not generic stats but your methodology, measured. So you see which edge is real and which leak costs you money.

b.h2: Prove your edge before you risk it.
b.lead: Backtest projects sit next to the journal, with the same fields and the same engine. Their results never touch your live numbers. Prove a setup on history first, then trade it with real money.
b.b1b: The same engine for R, drawdown and streaks runs on your backtests and your live book.
b.b2b: A backtest never inflates the live win rate or streaks. What you traded and what you tested stay apart.

t.lead: You chart and execute in TradingView. That's what you're good at, and we're not rebuilding it. Beyen adds the analysis layer on top: get your trades in and see what your method delivers. No chart of our own, no replay engine, by design.
t.n1b: TradingView, MetaTrader or your broker. Where you already are.
t.n2b: Logged in a few taps. Broker CSV import is coming.
t.n3b: Your method fields, real numbers, edge per setup.
t.note: CSV import is on the roadmap and coming soon. Everything else on this page works today.

f.lead: A journal you'll actually stay in. The tools are built in, not bolted on later.
f.c1b: Close the week with a guided review and export it to PDF.
f.c2b: Track several trading accounts and their balances side by side.
f.c3b: Share a clean report of any trade or review.
f.c4b: High-impact events, right inside the app.
f.c5b: Position sizing from your risk, in one tap.
f.c6b: The whole app in your language, switch any time.

p.lead: No stripped-down demo. The free tier is a full journal. You only pay for more: more journals and unlimited custom fields.
p.f2: Full analysis: R-multiples, drawdown, streaks, SQN

cta.lead: Create a free account and log your first trade within minutes.
